nodes.name: Daily 11:30
nodes.notes: INV-14: its OWN Schedule, independent of the send chain. Hung off the end of the sends, the daily watch would switch off precisely on Sundays and on days without candidates, which is when yesterday's pending cases need reporting. 11:30 because the backup runs at 10:00, so the day's report already includes it. STAYS DISABLED until the group 9 Go/No-Go.

nodes.name: Send Findings
nodes.notes: READ ONLY. alwaysOutputData is CRITICAL: a select with no results returns zero items, and with zero items n8n does not run what follows. The good day -zero stuck cases- would be indistinguishable from n8n being down. That would break INV-13 inside the very workflow that exists to guarantee INV-13.

parameters.query:
with base as (
  select * from bot.sends
  where patient_id <> 'TEST'      -- 7.1b: the test launcher leaves one row per demo
    and status <> 'reviewed'      -- spec 6: it is the only way the operator has to close a case
)
select 'pending' as finding, unique_key, patient_id, last_name, milestone, template,
       ycloud_id, null::text as detail,
       round(extract(epoch from (now() - created_at)) / 3600)::int as age_hours
from base
where status = 'pending' and created_at < now() - interval '1 hour'

union all
-- 7.1a: ambiguous is measured against CREATED_AT. That status does not write sent_at on
-- purpose, and comparing against null does not give false: it gives null, and the row is
-- not selected. Ambiguous rows would never expire.
select 'ambiguous_expired', unique_key, patient_id, last_name, milestone, template,
       ycloud_id, null::text,
       round(extract(epoch from (now() - created_at)) / 3600)::int
from base
where status = 'ambiguous' and created_at < now() - interval '12 hours'

union all
select 'unconfirmed', unique_key, patient_id, last_name, milestone, template,
       ycloud_id, null::text,
       round(extract(epoch from (now() - sent_at)) / 3600)::int
from base
where status = 'sent' and sent_at < now() - interval '12 hours'

union all
select 'failed_24h', unique_key, patient_id, last_name, milestone, template,
       ycloud_id,
       coalesce(error_code, 'no code') || ' - ' || coalesce(error_message, 'no detail'),
       round(extract(epoch from (now() - created_at)) / 3600)::int
from base
where status = 'failed' and created_at > now() - interval '24 hours'

union all
-- 6b.1: the failure path wrote the status and LOST the detail. It is our defect,
-- not the channel's, and that is why it goes as an alert separate from the normal list.
select 'failed_no_code', unique_key, patient_id, last_name, milestone, template,
       ycloud_id, coalesce(error_message, 'no detail'),
       round(extract(epoch from (now() - created_at)) / 3600)::int
from base
where status = 'failed' and error_code is null

union all
-- 5b.1 / V10: the opt1 -> opt2 alternation, detected BY ITS EFFECT on the day it
-- happens. The previous record is looked up in the WHOLE bot.sends, without excluding
-- reviewed: a send closed by hand is still history.
select 'alternation', e.unique_key, e.patient_id, e.last_name, e.milestone, e.template,
       e.ycloud_id,
       'previous: ' || prev.template || ' | now: ' || e.template ||
         case when prev.template = e.template then ' | REPEATED' else ' | OK' end,
       round(extract(epoch from (now() - e.created_at)) / 3600)::int
from base e
join lateral (
  select p.template
  from bot.sends p
  where p.patient_id = e.patient_id
    and p.milestone = e.milestone
    and p.created_at < e.created_at
  order by p.created_at desc
  limit 1
) prev on true
where e.milestone = '20' and e.created_at > now() - interval '24 hours'

order by 1, 2;

nodes.name: Error Findings
nodes.notes: READ ONLY. Receives ONE item from the previous envelope, so it runs a single time.

parameters.query:
-- Rows not notified: the Error Manager design hands picking them up to "the daily
-- heartbeat", and it created the partial index errors_unnotified for this query.
select 'error_unnotified' as finding,
       id::text as ref,
       workflow,
       node,
       message,
       to_char(occurred_at at time zone 'America/Costa_Rica', 'DD/MM HH24:MI') as occurred
from bot.errors
where not notified

union all
-- Count for the day: so that a real firing of the error manager SHOWS in the report.
select 'errors_24h', count(*)::text, null, null, null, null
from bot.errors
where occurred_at > now() - interval '24 hours'

union all
-- The evidence left by the backup (design B-E). If the row does not exist, this
-- still returns a row with an empty string, and the Code reads it as NO RECORD.
select 'last_backup', coalesce(max(value), ''), null, null, null, null
from bot.config
where name = 'last_backup'

order by 1;

nodes.notes: INV-13: this message goes out EVERY DAY, even when everything is at zero. INV-15: explicit parse_mode HTML; escaping is done in Write Report, on every value that comes from the database.
